summary: The registrant filed an 8-K reporting its second-quarter 2026 results and declaration of a regular quarterly dividend of $0.13 per share on Class A common stock, payable August 25, 2026, to holders of record August 11, 2026. No special-situation event (acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, restructuring, etc.) is present. The items disclosed are routine earnings and dividend declarations, typical of ordinary operating updates. The filing is a standard current report with no strategic or extraordinary corporate action, thus not classified as a special situation.
